scenarios.name: Assessment before update
given: An existing JSON file is provided for update
then: assess-practice.py is run first to determine suggestedUpdateMode
The update mode is auto-fix, remap, or full-reanalysis based on assessment output

scenarios.name: Backup before overwrite
given: The update will overwrite existing files
when: Any mode (auto-fix, remap, or full-reanalysis) begins
then: backup-practice.py has created a timestamped backup of the directory
The backup contains all JSON and markdown files

scenarios.name: Auto-fix mode applied when sufficient
then: Fix utilities are run without user interaction
Re-assessment confirms 0 errors before reporting success

scenarios.name: Dependency resolution before update
given: An extension practice is being updated
then: discover-dependencies.py resolves all baselinePracticeName and practiceDependencyNames
Resolved dependencies are confirmed with the user before proceeding

scenarios.name: Content preservation during remap
when: Existing content is extracted and remapped
then: All valid existing alphas, activities, work products, and narratives are preserved
Only superseded or invalid content is replaced

scenarios.name: Post-update validation required
then: eval-skill-output.py is run with error_pass_rate checked
The result is reported to the user with any remaining warnings

scenarios.name: Comparison report after update
given: A remap or full-reanalysis update has completed
then: diff-practice-json.py shows what changed vs the original
The user sees added, removed, and modified elements

scenarios.name: User confirms update mode when auto-fix insufficient
then: The user is asked to choose between remap and full-reanalysis
The recommended mode and reason from assessment are presented
